answer: The island admits a newcomer only against velvet staked for M epochs: the staked velvet collects no orchard fees and burns if the newcomer proves fake. Velvet takes its dye from its sponsor at weaving, so all descendants of one root share a dye, and the island prices the k-th newcomer of a dye at k velvets staked together — clone k idles k fee streams at once, k·M·base forgone, unsplittable since each velvet backs one stake. An outsider's velvet joins only for a bribe above its M-epoch fees; a root newcomer stakes one velvet.
